# Zq_Surface_Code

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A generalization of the surface code using qudits of dimension q, where logical information is encoded on a 2D lattice with Z_q stabilizer operators. Enables higher-dimensional encoding and potentially improved thresholds for fault-tolerant computation, relevant for robust topology-based computing fabrics.
